This paper, guided by the background of education informationization 2.0, explores the informationized-teaching reform of business English course in higher vocational colleges to promote students to "be able to learn", "desire to learn", "joy to learn" and "persist to learn", and to improve the teaching efficiency, so as to be helpful for the development of higher vocational education.

articleTitle: Research on Early Intelligent Warning Method of Lost Circulation Risk Based on SVM and PSO
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: For the traditional lost circulation early warning methods (such as expert system method and neural network method), there are problems such as difficulty in obtaining knowledge, poor real-time, large amount sample or easy to appear local optimal solution. An early intelligent warning method based on SVM and PSO is proposed, the method first establishes the lost circulation risk warning model based on SVM, and then uses PSO's powerful global search capability to optimize the parameters of SVM model to effectively solve the blindness of SVM model parameter optimization selection, and make the lost circulation early warning model based on SVM-PSO optimal. Tested by an oilfield measured data, the results show that the early warning method can predict the risk data in time, and has high prediction accuracy, which can meet the needs of drilling field applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of Unstructured Road Information Recognition Methods for Unmanned Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: At present, the unstructured road recognition degree of driverless vehicles is relatively low, which makes it difficult to guarantee the hidden danger of driving safety. Algorithm to solve the above problems, combined with color information recognition for the unstructured road grey value is calculated, thus effectively to obtain body boundary pixels of unstructured road and the road gray characteristic parameters, and according to the calculation results of unstructured road recognition method is optimized, using gray parameter characteristics of the unstructured road gray orthogonal method for optimization, in order to realize the unmanned vehicle the ultimate goal of unstructured road information identification. Finally, experimental results show that compared with the traditional road information recognition method, the unstructured road information recognition method combined with color information recognition algorithm has higher recognition degree and more stable operation.

articleTitle: UAV Cooperative MIMO Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the UAV load data transmission, MIMO technology and cooperative communication technology are applied to the practical application of UAV. Firstly, the MIMO system and the system structure and basic principles of V-BLAST are introduced. Then the principle of MMSE detection algorithm and the influence of antenna correlation on system performance are introduced. At last, using Matlab to simulate the performance of the system under different channel correlation and different modulation methods, the changes of the performance of the V-BLAST system based on the MMSE algorithm are changed with the change of the channel correlation coefficient and the modulation mode.

articleTitle: Research on Medical Service System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The purpose of the medical information sharing system based on big data in this paper is promoting the development of medical informatization, providing technical solutions and supporting conditions for the construction of regional medical informatization in China. The system is bound to promote the quality of medical information service by the application of big data and cloud computing and solve the "high cost but low efficiency" problem. This paper designs a service pattern that takes the patients as the center and realizes the reasonable distribution and sharing of medical resources. The system also provides experience and references for the medical service innovation in China. In this paper, a medical service system BDMSP which based on big data technology, is introduced. It describes the design of BDMSP from system architecture, key technologies, its application and etc. It may be a helpful research for application of big data technology.

articleTitle: Ground Target Localization Algorithm Based on UAV Aerial Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Ground target localization is of great importance in UAV aerial image analysis and computer vision, and many researchers have been studied on this topic. In this paper, we focus on the problem of ground target localization using the Multi-feature fusion technology. In this work, visual features are extracted from UAV images, and then visual similarity is calculated, on the other hand. Afterwards, the coordinate in coarse positioning result is estimated by the radiation transformation model and multi-feature fusion. The main innovation of this paper lies in that we effectively integrate different types of image visual features, such as color moments, color histogram, color correlogram, GLOM texture features, and Tamura texture features. Experimental results demonstrate that effectively integrating all these features, the accurate Ground target localization results can be achieved.

Author Keywords: Unmanned aerial vehicle, Target localization, Image processing, Multi-feature fusion

articleTitle: Research on Signal Control Method of Isolated Intersection Based on the Queuing Length Reliability
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Considering the stochastic characteristics of traffic flow at the approach of intersection, a signal control method based on the queuing length reliability is proposed. Firstly, the formula of queuing length is obtained according to the traffic wave theory, and then the signal timing method which satisfies a predetermined queuing length reliability is constructed with the assumption that the traffic flow of intersection approach follows a normal or a lognormal distribution. Finally, some numerical studies are presented to verify the proposed signal timing model.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Wireless Sensor Positioning Strategy Based on Improved Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the deficiencies of the population of the bat algorithm, which is easy to fall into the local optimum, the bat algorithm with inertia factor and Lévy flight strategy is proposed and applied in the positioning of WSN. The improved algorithm uses random Lévy flight to re-adjust the position of the bat algorithm. The updated method is used to verify the excellent performance of the improved algorithm in various aspects. Finally, the improved algorithm is applied to the node localization of wireless sensor networks(WSNs), and the algorithm is also used to solve the mathematical optimization problem in node localization. The simulation results show that compared with traditional bat algorithm and particle swarm algorithm(PSO), our strategy effectively reduces the computation in the positioning process, saves the time spent on positioning, and prolongs the life cycle of the whole network to certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Audio Fault Identification Method Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper proposes a new method for monitoring the health of transformers. Based on the tensorflow framework, the multi-layer neural network model is trained by using the audio signal of the transformer running. The BP back-propagation algorithm is used to iteratively train the whole network and randomly initialize the initial values. The parameter is adjusted by the error between the output and the label until global convergence. Its advantage lies in its ability to get rid of the dependence on a large number of signal processing technologies and expert diagnostic experience, to achieve adaptive extraction of fault features and intelligent identification of fault categories.

articleTitle: A Novel Control Method of Zero Sequence Circulation in Parallel Inverters
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of zero sequence circulation control of parallel inverters, a zero sequence circulation control method is proposed by using 111 and 000 two zero vectors in the process of re distribution of SVPWM modulation. The method can effectively reduce the zero sequence circulation, which makes the current loop control to the two inverter bridges, and the zero sequence current loop control is carried out respectively, which makes the two inverters to play the role of half of the zero sequence circulation control. This method does not increase the complexity and cost of the system, and it is not necessary to adjust the control strategy in parallel with the multi group inverters. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method are verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Data Classification Method Based on Class Attribute Mathematical Expectation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of complex data in large data era, the classification method of spatial data based on mathematical expectation theory of category attributes is improved and optimized. By optimizing the arithmetic of mathematical expectation function of data attributes, the mapping value of discrete attributes can be obtained, the mapping value features can be mined and the spatial dimension can be classified, and the mathematical expectation attributes of data can be used as parameter coordinates to determine the classification of data, and the spatial distance of data can be calculated according to the data. Feature attributes are used to plan the spatial scope of data classification, so as to finish the accurate classification of data effectively. Finally, the experiment proves that the classification method is real and effective, and the accuracy is obviously improved compared with the traditional classification method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Feature Extraction Methods of Multimedia Information Resources Based on Unstructured Database
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper analyzes the problems of excessive information resources and insufficient accuracy of data information resource representation and extraction. This paper proposes an analysis of multimedia information resource characterization extraction method based on unstructured database. First, the underlying structure of the database is optimized, and the data resource attributes are identified by combining with the data feature mining algorithm, and the low-level information resource features of the unstructured database are clustered, and the data representation extraction path is reasonably planned with reference to the information feature mining results of the underlying database. The covariance parameters in the extraction process of information resource representation are calculated with Gaussian function algorithm, so as to effectively check the extraction error of resource representation and realize the extraction method of multimedia information resource representation in unstructured database. Finally, the comparison experiment proves that the multimedia information resource representation extraction method based on unstructured database can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of information resource representation extraction compared with the traditional method.

articleTitle: Study on the Application of Order Agriculture in Precision Poverty Alleviation Based on Multiple Linear Regression Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In 2020, China will fully realize a well-off society. To achieve this goal, China's poverty alleviation work has entered a crucial stage. Under the background of the Internet era, the "Internet + Order Agriculture + Precision Poverty Alleviation" model has been formed, and the order agriculture has played an important role in promoting the development of precision poverty alleviation. Based on 1000 questionnaires in Hubei Province, this paper quantitatively studied the impact of contract farming on farmers' income levels using multiple linear regression methods. The research shows that there is a positive correlation between farmers' participation in contract farming and farmers' income, and the correlation coefficient is high, indicating that farmers' participation in contract farming can significantly increase their income. Therefore, the promotion of contract farming is conducive to the in-depth development of regional precision poverty alleviation, and can help farmers solve poverty problems.

Author Keywords: Order Agriculture, Precision Poverty Alleviation, Multiple Linear Regression

articleTitle: An Improved Bacterial Foraging Strategy for Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Under the background of image segmentation, the basic bacterial foraging algorithm(BFA) is analyzed intensively and improved in this paper. The fixed step size of chemotactic operator of traditional BFA is replaced by dynamic step size, and the fixed migration probability of its migration operator is replaced by dynamic migration probability. According to particle swarm optimization(PSO) strategy, the motion direction of bacteria is controlled and the global optimal search is delayed by the random selection of the motion direction of bacteria. The simulation analysis proves that when the improved algorithm is applied to the image segmentation, whether it is the segmentation unpreprocessed or the preprocessed image, the step size will be larger. All of them can find the optimal solution quickly and steadily which achieve better segmentation results.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Voice Interaction Model Based on Mobile Teaching Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the effect of voice interactive learning in mobile teaching, this paper analyses the system characteristics of Android architecture and the characteristics of voice interactive mode in embedded environment. Firstly, the specific speech recognition algorithm based on practical application background is studied, and the complexity and real-time performance of the algorithm module are analyzed. Then, a speech recognition algorithm, Dynamic Time Planning(DTW) is adopted in the off-line mode of the network, and the adaptability of the related algorithms is optimized to enable it to be more suitable for the application in Android embedded environment. At the same time, the speech recognition technology and speech synthesis technology are integrated, and the database technology in Android is used to synthesize several modules into a complete and comprehensive intelligent voice interaction system. Finally, the function of the system is tested as a whole and the test data show that the voice interaction model designed in this paper can achieve speech recognition and intelligent voice control more completely. The recognition speed is faster, and it can meet people's needs for efficient, simple and fast interaction.

articleTitle: Research on English Online Learning Behavior Analysis and Mining Method Based on Structural Equation Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the continuous development of Internet technology, the concept of Internet+ is also familiar to the public. Since English education is an integral part of our education, Internet + education products are also emerging. Especially in recent years, online English learning platforms have also attracted the attention of students, parents and teachers. However, in the face of this new thing, many people have a skeptical attitude. Therefore, this paper has carried out systematic research in the context of online learning in English. Firstly, the concept, classification and characteristics of online learning are introduced. Then the specific application of structural equation model is introduced. By referring to the literature, the influencing factors of current online learning behavior in English are summarized, and the theoretical relationship model is constructed. The questionnaire is designed and the letter is sent. Degree and validity test, and finally use the structural equation model to fit and verify the rationality of the research hypothesis. Studies have shown that hardware facilities, learning willingness, learning motivation, learning strategies, platform management, economic conditions and English online learning behaviors and mining methods have a significant impact.

articleTitle: Bilingual Printed Document Image Retrieval Based on SIFT Feature
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper present a printed document retrieval system which can retrieve Chinese and Uyghur keywords from printed document images. In this paper we introduce the framework of the printed document retrieval system and processing step behind it which can be based line for the word spotting based document retrieval system, we also describe the extraction algorithm that use local feature as SIFT to extract the feature from image and use Euclidean based matching algorithm to query the matching word in printed document image. Some novel idea applied in this system might be helpful for some Other Bilingual printed document image retrieve system.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control of Key Process Parameters in Dense Medium Coal Preparation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Due to the time-varying, nonlinear and strongly coupled characteristics of the density control of dense medium suspension and the liquid level control of qualified medium bucket, the traditional independent control strategy cannot effectively coordinate the control. Through mechanism analysis and parameter identification, we established the density and liquid level transfer function under the influence of add water, add medium and split-flow, and proposed the control strategy combining feedforward compensation and decoupling control to realize the coordinated control of the density of dense medium suspension and the liquid level of qualified medium bucket. The experimental results show that the control strategy has shorter adjustment time and smaller overshoot under external disturbance.

Author Keywords: liquid level of qualified medium bucket

articleTitle: Research on Feasibility Path of Technology Supervision and Technology Protection in Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Big data will bring revolutionary changes from life to thinking for society as a whole. At the same time, the massive data and potential value of big data are subject to many security risks. Aiming at the above problems, a data privacy protection model for big data platform is proposed. First, the data privacy protection model of big data for data owners is introduced in detail, including protocol design, logic design, complexity analysis and security analysis. Then, the query privacy protection model of big data for ordinary users is introduced in detail, including query protocol design and query mode design. Complexity analysis and safety analysis are performed. Finally, a stand-alone simulation experiment is built for the proposed privacy protection model. Experimental data is obtained and analyzed. The feasibility of the privacy protection model is verified.

articleTitle: Statistical Decision Research of Long-Term Deposit Subscription in Banks Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: It is particularly important to effectively mine potential customers and provide differentiated services for them to improve the competitiveness of banks with the strong competition among banks. This paper uses decision tree algorithm to analyze factors that affect whether bank customers subscribe to fixed deposits or not, and constructs a decision tree model of influencing factors of bank customers subscribe to fixed deposit business. The results show that the three factors that significantly affect customers' subscription for long-time deposits are the number of employees, duration and month, which greatly reduce the scope of customers that banks push to subscribe for long-term deposits, and are conducive to improving the efficiency of banks.

articleTitle: Design of Virtual Display System for Guangxi Minority Scenic Spots Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This project aims to use the virtual reality technology to build a virtual tourism system in Guangxi minority scenic spots, explore interactive display technology in virtual systems, focus on interactive virtual display design and production methods, improve user experience, and enable visitors to Experience the fun of virtual tourism in an immersive way, and enhance the value and image of ethnic minority scenic spots, and enhance the core competitiveness of the scenic spot.

articleTitle: Optimization Research on Vehicle Scheduling Path for Emergency Repairs of Power Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Optimization research on vehicle scheduling path for emergency repairs of power transmission lines is the problem how the repair vehicles can quickly reach the repair scene along the optimal path, is the problem of finding the optimal path. In this paper, a method of dynamically dividing the search area is proposed in order to narrow the search range and improve the search speed. At the same time, in view of the shortcomings that the road network topology map can't use the real-time traffic information as the weight, this paper adopts the genetic-improved Max-Min Ant System (MMAS) algorithm. Using the average waiting time of road sections in different time periods as an integral part of visibility calculation, the optimal combination of the five control parameters is obtained by using the genetic-modified MMAS algorithm, then using this combination to guide the improved MMAS algorithm to find the optimal path. Simulation results show that this method has more advantages than other methods in solving the optimal repair path of power line.

articleTitle: Simulation of Consumer Purchase Behavior Based on Computational Experiments
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Many factors influence the consumer purchase behavior. This paper presents an agent-based modeling and simulation method on the consumer's purchasing behaviors based on quality, price and promotion. The key point of this model is the utility function and this model is implemented under simulation environment. The results show that the proposed model can analyze and predict the effects of different quality, price and promotion strategies by the emergence of consumer purchasing behaviors.

articleTitle: Influence of the Blade Angle of Guide Vane Outlet on the Performance of Lifting Electric Pump in Deep Sea Mining
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to study the influence of different blade angle of guide vane outlet on the hydraulic performance of lifting electric pump in deep sea mining, four schemes with different blade angles of guide vane outlet were designed. Under different operating conditions, the numerical simulations were performed on the lifting electric pumps of the four schemes, and the accuracy of the numerical simulation results was verified by model tests. The results show that the efficiency and head characteristics of the lifting electric pump decrease with the blade angle of the guide vane outlet, and the area of the low speed zone of the guide vane tail increases with the increase of the blade angle of the guide vane outlet. As the blade angle of the guide vane outlet decreases, the static pressure distribution in the pump becomes more uniform, and pressure fluctuations and particle velocity fluctuations become smaller. In the four schemes, when the blade angle of the guide vane outlet is 70°, the hydraulic loss of the guide vane is relatively minimal, the efficiency and head of the lifting electric pump are relatively highest, the supercharging capacity is the strongest, and the pressure field and velocity field distribution are greatly improved compared with the other blade angles.

articleTitle: Research on Improvement of Mass Multimedia Information Filtering Technology Under Multi - Data Inflow
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of poor timeliness and low accuracy of traditional information filtering, the mass multimedia information filtering technology under multi-data influx was improved. Combined with the adaptive top-level feature filtering algorithm, the screening matrix of bad content in media information is designed, and the information keyword feature parameters are calculated. Combined with the calculation results, the filtering rules of combined network information are formulated, and the structure of multimedia information filtering program is improved based on the filtering rules of network information. By optimizing the information data filtering feature capture module and improving the logical relationship of information filtering, the improvement of mass multimedia information filtering technology under the influx of multiple data is completed. Finally, through experiments, it is proved that the improved effect of mass multimedia information filtering technology combined with adaptive top-level feature filtering algorithm under multi-data influx has significantly improved the accuracy and timeliness of traditional information filtering methods, and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Design of Data Interchange Platform for Digital Highway
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A digital highway data exchange platform of Foshan city has been planned. Through analyzing of the status quo, The real demand of building a data exchange platform is proposed. By via of building a series of data exchange standards and constructing data center. The feasible system frame has been built for data exchange platform.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Home Control System Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming to improve the control ability of smart home, a design scheme of wireless communication control system for intelligent home based on machine learning is proposed. The wireless transmission module, the ZigBee data acquisition module, the AD module, the bus transmission module and the man-machine interface module of the intelligent home control system are constructed. Machine learning algorithm is used to design the control algorithm of intelligent home control system. The robustness of intelligent home control is improved by combining fuzzy PID control scheme. The steady-state error compensation method is adopted to improve the anti-dry-ability of intelligent home control. Combining machine learning algorithm to realize global optimization of intelligent home control. The network module and communication module of the intelligent home control system are constructed under the Zigbee network control protocol, and the hardware design of the intelligent home control system is realized under the integrated DSP environment. The simulation results show that the system has good robustness and stability, and improves the self-adaptability and global stability of smart home control.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Super Mall System Based on SOA Distributed Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A B2C platform e-commerce system is completed by analysing the current mainstream e-commerce system functions. The system uses a distributed architecture including search system, single sign-on system, backstage system, order system, shopping cart system, data analysis system. The use of RPC(Remote Procedure Call) protocol to achieve communication between the system. The message queue mechanism improves the speed of response to the user, using Nosql database Redis as a cache. The use of a large number of technologies achieve high cohesion low coupling principle Server to reduce the pressure on the database to read and write. The use of AOP(Aspect-Oriented Programming) ideas on the database achieve the database read and write separation. The system uses Tomcat as a Web application server, database using MYSQL, Nginx as a Web server load load balancing and reverse proxy. Each system pass Dubbo communication to achieve mutual cooperation function. The system pass functional testing. it has good stability. According to the results of the stress test, virtual machine server can do the number of concurrent 400 under the cycle request 100 times. It is the error rate of 5%. If the nodes are clustered, the compression effect will be better. The flexibility can be designed for different requests.

Author Keywords: Distributed, e-commerce, decoupling, data analysis, RabbitMQ, Zookeeper

articleTitle: The Application of VR Technology in the Construction of Learning Resources of Mobile Application Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: with the development of science and technology, three dimensional (3D) computer interaction, virtual reality and other technologies are used to improve the form of teaching demonstration and create an interactive teaching platform for visual illusion, so that the teaching effect can be greatly improved. Based on the design and implementation of visual illusion teaching platform under the Unity3D digital three-dimensional interactive technology, 3Dmax software is used to construct the 3D virtual learning scene of the system and the 3D model of "contradictory space", an important content of visual illusion. Unity3D is used as a system development platform for implementing functions such as virtual roaming and human-computer interaction. The technical methods and key technologies of digital interactive teaching system are discussed, and the most effective visual illusion teaching platform is built. Finally, the completed visual illusion teaching platform – "visual illusion 3D interactive learning system" is systematically tested and analyzed from the aspects of software performance and system application effect. The results show that the visual illusion teaching platform with virtual reality technology achieves the expected effect well, and the use of this teaching platform can improve students' ability to understand and apply the teaching content of "visual illusion".

articleTitle: Experimental Study on CFRP Strengthened Continuous Reinforced Concrete Slab After Fire
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper presents results from experimental studies on the flexural capacity mechanical properties of a continuous reinforced concrete (RC) slab with and without carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) sheets strengthened. Fire test and flexural capacity test were carried out on one continuous RC slab. Heating curve included heating stage and cooling stage. One span of continuous RC slab was strengthened with CFRP sheets at sagging moment region and hogging moment region. The results showed that the fire exposure surface of RC slab was easy to concrete spalling. The temperature variation of concrete obviously lagged behind the phenomenon. When the furnace temperature was decreasing, the temperature of concrete of the slab was still rising. Compared maximum temperatures within 120 minutes with the temperature of end heating at the same measuring point, the farther away from the fire exposure surface, the greater the temperature increased. And the time of maximum temperatures was also increased with the distance increase of from the fire exposure surface. The surface should be repaired before strengthened with CFRP sheets. CFRP sheets strengthening improved the flexural bearing capacity and stiffness of the fire-damaged slab, however, reduced the ductility of the fire-damaged slab. CFRP sheets could develop their ability in strengthening fire-damaged RC slabs on condition that surface processing of fire-damaged concrete.

articleTitle: An Energy Consumption Control Scheme Based on Radial Basis Function in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Wireless sensor network node is resource constrained and difficult to replace its power. How to reduce energy consumption effectively is the practical problem. Existing literatures most designs solutions for a single application and performance evaluation protocols. Since the single node usually executes multiple applications, it is necessary to study the optimal energy consumption control scheme based on cross-application. The paper proposes a cross-application energy saving mechanism based on RBF for wireless sensor networks to control node energy consumption. Estimating cluster center using k-means clustering self-organizing algorithm based on neural network radial basis function. Then adjust and modify the weight matrix of the cluster center by Least Mean Square algorithm to realize data fusion. The simulation experiment results show that the node consumption can be significantly reduced after several rounds.

articleTitle: Parallel Optimization of Depth Learning Algorithm Based on Behavior Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low parallel processing efficiency of current deep learning algorithm data, a parallel optimization method of deep learning algorithm based on behavior recognition is proposed. The behavior recognition method is used to extract learning morphological features, and the clustering specification parameters of deep learning features are calculated. The learning state feature values and clustering specification parameters are compared according to the calculation results, so as to effectively check out the heterogeneous data hidden in the parallel processing process. The parallel processing execution steps are optimized according to the parameters of the depth learning feature clustering specification, and the control flow of the parallel processing of the behavior depth learning is improved by planning the parallel rules of the depth learning algorithm, so as to finally achieve the research goal of the parallel optimization of the depth learning algorithm based on the behavior recognition. Finally, experiments show that the parallel optimization efficiency of the depth learning algorithm based on behavior recognition is significantly higher than that of the traditional depth learning algorithm.

articleTitle: The Measurement, Calculation and Evaluation of Service Sensitivity of the Development of New Product in Automotive Industry — An Example of CIVIC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper presents a study of the changes of the main function index of the improvement and new model development of the main producing model of CIVIC, from 2011 to 2015. Using the collection and analysis of the data and the calculation of the index of service sensitivity, it was evaluated that the influence of the development and the sale of the new product from the service sensitivity under the service-leading supply chain condition.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Speech Interaction Model for Mobile Teaching
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Intelligent answer system is a novel information service system which integrates and applies information retrieval, natural language processing, artificial intelligence and semantic analysis to respond users' questions in intelligence and accuracy. This paper focuses on Chinese questions answering matching task and puts forward intensive learning-based questions-answering matching method. First, we study words vector and the model from sequence to sequence, to design and generate questions answering-typed model. Then, we introduces neural network-based sequence mapping model, uses lots of questions answering-paired corpus training model and learns mapping relationship between questions sequence and answer sequence. After the model training is over, the model can generate corresponding answers of questions according to users' inputting questions. Finally, the influence of different comparison experiment tests on system performance and experiment data designs by us show that the model is feasible in practical application.

articleTitle: Painting Semantic Classification Method Based on Image Visual Feature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Painting semantic classification is of great importance in computer vision, and the main difficult in it is how to fully and effectively analyze visual features in images. Therefore, in this paper, we proposed a novel painting semantic classification method, in which the visual features are extracted from Convolutional neural networks, and svm classifier is used to solve the classification task. Particularly, we choose the CNN features as image visual features, which are extracted from the pool5 layer in GoogLeNet. Then, we propose a novel hybrid QPSO-SVM model to achieve quality painting semantic classification, and the SVM parameters are optimized by the QPSO algorithm. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that our proposed algorithm can achieve high classification accuracy for all types of painting images.

Author Keywords: Painting semantic, Image classification, Visual feature, Convolutional neural networks, SVM

articleTitle: Design of a High Precision Automatic Resistance Measuring Instrument
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In modern times, we usually use digital multimeter to measure the value of resistance, but when using multimeter to measure resistance, we need to shift gears manually. On the other hand, when we measure the resistance with unknown resistance value, we must adjust the test range of the multimeter several times before we can determine the resistance value. This results in long test time and low test efficiency. In order to overcome this shortcoming, this paper designs a resistance testing device that can automatically adjust the measuring range, which can automatically screen the measuring range, saving the testing time and improving the testing efficiency. The device uses the STM32 chip as its core controller. The instrument includes a core control circuit, an A/D conversion circuit, a range switching circuit, a display circuit, and a test circuit. The constant current method is used to generate multiple constant current outputs, and the function of automatic resistance measurement is achieved by switching the relay to get different range. The instrument can measure the resistance of 0~1M, which has a good use value.

articleTitle: Research on Thermal Analysis of an Aviation Spiral Bevel Gear Transmission Shafting
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To study the lubrication performance of an aviation spiral bevel gear transmission shafting, applying theories of tribology and heat transfer, thermal analysis of the entire transmission shafting was performed based on the software platform of ANSYS Workbench. The steady-state temperature field were obtained, where the influence of rotational speed and torque were discussed. The results show that in the aviation spiral bevel gear transmission shafting, the highest temperature appears at the contact areas of outer ring raceway and rollers of the 'compressed' bearing. Furthermore, the highest temperature of the driving gear increase respectively with the increasing of rotational speed and torque. Finally, the experimental data is basically consistent with the simulation results, which verifies the feasibility of the simulation method.

articleTitle: Semantic Classification and Retrieval Method of Arts and Crafts Images Based on Visual Feature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Content-based image retrieval technology overcomes the defect of subjective one-sidedness of text retrieval method and objectively describes the essential features of images. However, the semantic description of images in text mode is lost, which leads to the reduction of retrieval accuracy. To improve the performance of the retrieval system, image semantic description is used to improve the human-machine interface and interactive performance of the retrieval system. Then, the proposed visual feature-semantic classification algorithm is experimented to test its performance. The results on a random image set show that the proposed algorithm has better retrieval performance than traditional semantic classification algorithm and correlation sorting algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Property Management System Based on B/S
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the current backward situation of property management, the system uses JSP technology to develop and design a Web-based community property management system based on B/S mode, which mainly realizes login management, housing management, administrative management, charge management, and community culture management. Functional modules have laid the foundation for the intelligent and informationalization of property management in the future.

articleTitle: Design of a Cloud Platform for Digital Highway
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern transportation technology and information technology, digital highway construction has continuously penetrated into various stages of highway planning, design, construction, operation and maintenance. After the unremitting efforts during the 12th Five-Year Plan period, China's highway industry has strengthened. Innovative ability and increased investment in science and technology have initially carried out information construction and laid a solid foundation for the development of the modern highway industry. Based on the existing system database, sort out the basic data and business database construction specifications, build the “cloud data center” of the highway industry in Foshan, and build a digital highway infrastructure database on this basis; With the goal of unified application and maintenance of dynamic and static data, a set of data standards is established, and the data source format is standardized to make it the basic data of each business system. At the same time, the cloud backup center software and hardware platform is built to realize data exchange, data sharing and data backup.

articleTitle: Design of a Multi-interface Telecommunication Cable Tester
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A telecommunication cable tester is designed to improve telecommunication cable test mode and test efficiency at the same time. The telecommunication cable tester implements the cable connectivity test by means of high and low level scanning. By changing the way of circuit composition, it can test the connectivity of cable according to a certain order. The tester adopts a multi socket terminal box, which is suitable for cables with common interfaces and the test results can be presented intuitively.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Different Expansive Agent on Internal Strain of Offshore Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to study the different dosage of expansive agent on the offshore wind caps internal strain change influence, in laboratory scale experiments, the area of different proportion of pile caps is obtained according to the experiment model of internal concrete strain condition, to determine the optimal dosage of expansive agent, expansive agent for actual wind caps engineering used to provide guidance. The experiment shows that the content of 8% is the optimal dosage, and the model of the bearing table has no tensile strain in the internal concrete of 8% content area, which effectively controls the generation of harmful cracks.

articleTitle: A Distributed Event-Triggered-Based Control Strategy and its Stability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of stable control strategy for microgrids with reactive power sharing. Firstly, the idea of multi-agent is introduced to construct the model of microgrid. Then, based on the droop-voltage control, the event-triggered control method is employed to design a control strategy. And an event-triggered-based controller for the reactive power sharing is proposed. Based on those work, the Lyapunov method is introduced to analyze the stability of constructed microgrid system. Finally, a new stability criterion is obtained.

articleTitle: Fatigue Life Analysis and Its Correction Coefficient of Stress Intensity Factor for Selectively Repaired Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Stress intensity factor of the selectively repaired structure and its correction coefficient are calculated by using the finite element method. The data is estimated by the MATLAB based on the nonlinear regression analysis. The relationship between the correction factor of the crack tip stress intensity factor and the normalized crack length and the normalized patch width is obtained. The fatigue residual life of selectively repaired structure is obtained by using the correction factor of the stress intensity factor and the Paris equation. The error is about 9% by the comparison of experiment, therefore, the correction factor of the stress intensity factor has certain reliability.

articleTitle: A Chinese Text Classier Based on Strong Class Feature Selection and Bayesian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: For improve the efficiency and accuracy of Chinese text categorization, this paper presents a new Chinese text classier, in which word segmentation system is based on forward scan corpus, and word frequency statistics method is different in the training stage and the test stage, after that, a novel feature selection is proposed according to word frequency, mutual information and classificatory information, Finally a fast Bayes theory classier is designed. Experiments prove this classier is simple and effective.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-sensor Information Fusion in Deceleration Early Warning System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper summarizes the general principles of multi-sensor data fusion. In order to solve the problems of inaccurate information and missing detection of single sensor, millimeter wave radar and infrared thermal detection are selected as fusion data sources by comparing the typical sensors in common use. A two-stage fusion detection and recognition scheme based on millimeter wave radar and infrared thermal detection is proposed to improve the accuracy of target recognition and reduce missing detection rate.

articleTitle: Computer Optimization of Food Nutrition Formula Based on the Consideration of Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Food nutrition is related to the national welfare and the people's livelihood, while frequent food safety incidents have tested people's lives and put them at risk again and again. With the rapid development of the Internet, computer optimization of food nutrition formula (hereinafter referred to as COFNF for short) has become an important method to solve the food nutrition problems in our country. In this paper, a kind of computer optimization method for the food nutrition formula based on the consideration of the adaptive genetic algorithm as the core is put forward. The computer optimization of the food nutrition formula is generated by the matrix decomposition based on the consideration of the heterogeneous data. In this system, the food nutrition information and the sign-in data are combined in an effective manner; and at the same time, they are merged into the same system to achieve the complementary advantages. The system that takes the complementary advantages into consideration can make more accurate prediction about the preference of the users. It is found in this study through experiments that: Compared with the other mainstream computer optimization of the food nutrition formula, the COFNF algorithm has relatively significant improvement in both the accuracy index and the recall rate index.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Campus Platform Data Integration System Based on Xml
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the current campus data integration system is not effective in processing local heterogeneous data, the data integration system of digital campus platform based on XML is optimized. By optimizing the hardware configuration, perfecting the data converter structure in the system, perfecting the characteristic conversion and integration process of heterogeneous data, calculating the standard parameters of heterogeneous data characteristic conversion combined with the scheduling algorithm, normalizing the heterogeneous data according to the standard parameters, and carrying out efficient data integration in the data converter after completing the normalization process combined with the optimized heterogeneous data characteristic conversion and integration process, so as to complete the design goal of the data integration system based on the XML digital campus platform. Finally, the experiment proves that compared with the traditional data integration system, the data integration rate of the XML - based digital campus platform data integration system for heterogeneous data has increased by more than 20%, and the processing effect has improved significantly compared with the traditional data integration system.

articleTitle: Software Design of Automatic Parking Robot Based on Flat Stereo Garage
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper introduces an agv robot for automatic parking in a flat stereo garage. The agv is independently developed by our company and has the functions of driving along a fixed path, autonomous navigation, two-stage anti-collision, sound and light alarm. It is characterized by heavy load and can be used for automatic parking of all household models up to 2.5t. Fast driving speed up to 3m/s. It can spin in place without setting the turning radius, thus making the garage more compact and the car density can be increased by 65% compared with the ordinary garage. Automatically find the charging position and charge it, it can work 24 hours a day, greatly improving the use and operation efficiency of the entire garage, greatly improving the economic and social benefits of the garage.

articleTitle: Research on Balise Message Coding Based on Extended Window Unequal Protection Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of railway operating speed, the efficient and secure transmission of balise message is a key problem in the present study. The decoding process of balise message has nothing to do with the secondary sequence of coding symbol reaching decoding end . This paper uses an optimized degree distribution fountain code to realize unequal error protection of data. Data with different levels of importance are protected by different mechanisms. Window W1 where MIB is stored adopts truncated degree distribution and window W2 LIB uses RSD degree distribution. Matlab simulation is used to obtain the decoding failure size under different code lengths. Simulation results show that: Using the unequal error protection of optimization degree distribution can ensure that the high priority data can be better protected. The theoretical feasibility of this method is verified.

articleTitle: Path Selection for Strengthening the Valid Propagation of Socialist Core Values Based on the Consideration of Structural Equation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In recent years, some propagation paths in the socialist core values have adopted invalid means to carry out the network propagation activities, which have seriously disrupted the normal social order. However, the research methods of the traditional propagation path mainly rely on manual analysis, which has poor efficiency and is not suitable for the study of the mass propagation path. Aiming at solving the aforementioned problems, an valid propagation path of the socialist core values that takes the structural equation into consideration is put forward in this paper, in which the propagation path is analyzed from three aspects as the following: the state of the propagation path, the historical socialist core values and the neighbors of the propagation path. In addition, structural equation is used to carry out the automatic path selection on the normal propagation paths and other propagation paths. The experimental results show that the method put forward in this paper can be used to carry out valid study on the valid path that can strengthen the propagation of the socialist core values, and the accuracy rate is as high as 95%.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of Urban Skeleton Road Network and External Freeway Network Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The reasonable connection between the external freeway network and the urban road network can alleviate the traffic pressure in the city. The fusion evaluation between the external freeway network and the urban road network are studied. Firstly, considering from three aspects of the facilities and the service performance and the connection point operation quality, the evaluation indicator system of two networks is established. Then, based on the cloud model and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, the fusion evaluation method based on cloud model - fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method of two networks is established, and the fusion evaluation process is determined. Finally, the effectiveness and scientific of the fusion evaluation method are verified by a case analysis of the skeleton road network and the external freeway of Changsha city.

articleTitle: A Construction Method of Security Mechanism Requirement for Wireless Access System Based on CC Standard
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the incomplete and incomplete security mechanism of wireless access system in emergency communication network, this paper proposes a security mechanism requirement construction method for wireless access system based on security evaluation standard. This paper discusses the requirements of security mechanism construction in wireless access system from three aspects: the definition of security issues, the construction of security functional components and security assurance components. This method can comprehensively analyze the security threats and security requirements of wireless access system in emergency communication network, and can provide correct and reasonable guidance and reference for the establishment of security mechanism.

articleTitle: Study on Explosion Safety Distance in LPG Tank Fire
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: According to the hazardous characteristics of LPG storage tanks and their types and hazards of fire and explosion accidents, the impact evaluation method, the shock wave overpressure criterion and the heat flux criterion are applied to the standard of human injury. Fire shock wave and heat radiation generated by three different accident types were calculated. The quantitative estimation model of safety distance and LPG reserves was studied, which provided a supplementary basis for the personnel evacuation and firefighter command and decision on LPG fire scene.

articleTitle: Research on Intrusion Data Mining Algorithm Based on Multiple Minimum Support
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The traditional single minimum support data mining algorithm has some problems, such as too much space occupied by data, resulting in insufficient accuracy of the algorithm, which is difficult to meet the needs of the development of the times. Therefore, an intrusion data mining algorithm based on multiple minimum support is proposed. First, the feature parameters of frequent itemsets of intrusion data are extracted, and the sequence itemsets are divided according to the feature parameters. Then, the data mining features are transformed with the equivalent binary data transformation method, and the multi-support tree structure is optimized according to the data processing results. Data classification mining is carried out with the data tree structure information, and the intrusion data features are deeply mined. Finally, the research of the intrusion data mining algorithm based on the multi-minimum support is completed. Through comparative experiments, it is proved that the accuracy of the intrusion data mining algorithm based on multiple minimum support is 35 % - 75 % higher than that of the traditional single minimum support data mining algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Tutoring System Based on Data-Mining Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper takes the composition of the intelligent teaching system and the realization process of the system as study core, to introduce the process of the design and realization of each component of the intelligent tutoring system. It adopts data mining association rules and decision tree mining algorithm to enhance the intelligence and personalization of the intelligent tutoring system. In the course of the design, the thought of evaluating the students' learning effect by changing the traditional expert model is used, according to the constructivist teaching theory, and the expert model is adjusted based on the students' learning effect. The experimental results show that the application of data mining technology to the decision-making of teaching management in colleges enable the decision-makers to be more pertinent in decision making, and it has certain practical guiding significance.

articleTitle: Design of a Rapid Development Model for Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A rapid development model for mobile internet was presented and a rapid development software system was built according to analysis of procedure and features of mobile internet development. There is no need writing a single line of code to rapidly building various management system which greatly shorten development procedure. The applications developed with the suggested model and software are dynamic and adaptive which can consist of multiple subsystems or modules. Moreover, developers can add or modify any business logic. The rapid development model and software can build and type of mobile internet application.

articleTitle: Numerical Study the Performance of Jet Fans in Utility Tunnel Ventilation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The urban utility tunnel needs efficient ventilation systems, which contributes to maintain air quality in the utility tunnel. In order to improve ventilation performance, the jet fans were used in the utility tunnel. Fluent 14.0 and k-ε turbulence model were applied to research the ventilation performance with jet fan with a deflected angle. Results showed that the air velocity is higher in the upstream of fire source than in downstream fire source. Typically, the deflected angle of jet fan has a certain effect on the velocity and temperature distribution of air in utility tunnel. The optimal deflected angle of jet fans was γ=12° near the fire source.

articleTitle: Designing Trajectories in Natural Parameter Curve with Improved Ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: When a natural parameter curve (NPC) is used for the well trajectory, the curve formulation is a nonlinear transcendental equation set. However, the existing iterative solution method presents such disadvantages as difficult initial value selection, local optima trapping, and low convergence speed. An improved ant colony optimization named IACO is proposed in this study to overcome these advantages effectively. Firstly, a nonlinear constraint equation with an objective function for designing an NPC trajectory is established to minimize the sum of the squared deviations of borehole trajectory coordinates. The ranges of well measured depth increment, inclination angle, and azimuth angle are used as constraints. Secondly, by using the unequal length discretization method to mesh the continuous space of constraints and objective function difference as the heuristic function to improve the ACO to solve the nonlinear constraint equation. Finally, through a case verification shows that the proposed IACO exhibits good convergence speed and accuracy and can provide engineering designers with a scientific and effective computation method.

articleTitle: Study on Big Data Based Land Use Performance in Yunnan Province
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on large data, this paper takes sixteen prefectures in Yunnan Province as the object of study to establish the evaluation system with land use performance as the destination layer and land input level, land use degree, land use efficiency and sustainability of land use as the criterion layer for elevating the land use performance by collecting land use and social & economic development data in the study area from 2005 to 2014 by the method of TOPSIS. And it gets conclusions as follows: (1) The overall level of land use performance in Yunnan Province is not high. Most areas experienced a low to intermediate transition in land use performance, and thus the level of land use is low; (2) From 2005 to 2014, the land use performance in Kunming, Qujing, Baoshan and Honghe was on the rise, while that in the other twelve regions, including Lijiang and Dali, was fluctuating upward; (3) There is a big gap in land use performance within Yunnan Province.

articleTitle: Dual-Channel Image Acquisition System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A high-speed image acquisition and display system is designed. Artix-7 series FPGA is used as the system control core, DDR3 SDRAM is the high-speed memory core device, the CMOS OV5640 sensor is used as an image acquisition device and HDMI is used as a display device. Verilog HDL is used to initialize the CMOS sensor. The reading and writing control of DDR3 SDRAM module and the control of HDMI module are implemented, so the system can acquire and display images. The experimental results show that the system acquires in real time and display the dual-channel images with a resolution of 640*720, which provides a reliable platform for binocular stereo vision algorithms.

articleTitle: Improvement of Face Recognition Technology Based on Intelligent Image
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Traditionally, the face recognition algorithm based on principal component analysis (PCA) is not robust to the change of skin color and pose. In order to solve this problem, a dynamic face recognition algorithm based on block sample feature matching is proposed. According to the principal component feature decomposition algorithm, each block feature quantity is projected onto the base coordinates of the test face sample set. The average mutual information entropy of each module vector quantization coding is used to represent the weight of the module, and the corner detection and texture matching of the face are carried out. The weight of the module is given to the feature face projection of the module, and face recognition is optimized. The simulation results show that the algorithm has good feature matching and high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Application Research of Virtual Reality Technology in Interior Design
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the practice in interior design industry, this paper studies the latest development of computer graphics in hardware, software and algorithm. With the study on realistic image generation algorithm of computer and real-time rendering technology, this paper uses accelerator engine of NVIDIA company including ray tracing engine OptiX, scene management engine SceniX and physical engine PhysX to design a GPU-based real-time rendering. Then, it chooses the most suitable virtual reality technologies, designs an interior design software system with rapid modeling and real-time high realism roamed function and realizes the design development of system prototype. Finally, we take one home-engineering as an example to test the effect of system application, compare and analyze benefits and effects which are brought by virtual reality technology.

articleTitle: Study on Seepage Characteristics and Complex Well Pattern in Low Permeability Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Experimental research on the joint development of horizontal and vertical wells is carried out in this paper. Four well patterns (VIVP, HIVP, VIHP and HIHP) were used to compare the advantages and disadvantages of water-injection and oil-production in horizontal and vertical wells. It is concluded that HIHP well pattern can form linear drive, delay injection water breakthrough time, improve sweep efficiency and reservoir recovery rate; horizontal wells are more suitable as production wells.

articleTitle: Intelligent Predictive Analysis of the Performance Level of Discipline Construction in Local Universities Based on Grey Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the difficulties in measurement data collecting of the performance level of discipline construction in local universities, GM (1, 1) grey prediction model was used to predict and analyze the performance level of discipline construction in local universities, which combined with the general performance indicator system of discipline construction. The research shows that to improve the performance level of discipline construction, we must strengthen the construction of teaching staff, ensure sufficient and high-quality teaching resources, optimize the process of personnel training, promote the development of students, strengthen quality supervision and guarantee, enhance the scientific research ability and awareness of teachers and students, clarify the orientation and goals of universities and actively promote the economic and social development of the country and the region.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-module Feature Fusion of Putonghua Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of pronunciation and evaluation of Chinese Putonghua, it is necessary to deal with the multi-module feature fusion of Putonghua. A comparative method of pattern recognition is proposed based on genetic algorithm (GA) and high order spectrum feature fusion of Putonghua pronunciation in Chinese Putonghua pronunciation standardization. The acquisition model of Chinese Putonghua speech pronunciation signal is constructed, and the filter processing and adaptive feature matching of the collected Mandarin speech signal are carried out to extract the statistical feature quantity of Putonghua speech signal. The method of spectral feature analysis was used to fuse the pronunciation features of Putonghua, and the correlation was detected according to the action attributes of phonetic organs. The high order spectrum characteristics of Chinese Putonghua speech pronunciation signal are extracted, and the modeling and adaptive learning of Chinese Putonghua speech pronunciation feature are carried out by means of statistical average detection and genetic evolutionary algorithm, and the adaptive optimization is carried out according to the genetic evolution process. The multi-module feature fusion of Putonghua is realized, which provides a standardized contrast mode for pronunciation. The simulation results show that the method has high accuracy in speech pronunciation feature detection and pattern recognition, improves the ability of multi-module feature fusion of Putonghua, and is effective and reliable for acoustic modeling of Putonghua pronunciation features. It has good application value in guiding the study and training of Putonghua.

articleTitle: Oil Spill Identification in SAR Image Using Curvelet Transform and SVM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: at present, the problem of marine pollution caused by oil spill accidents is increasingly serious. Rapid and accurate automatic recognition of SAR images provides an important prerequisite for the handling and decision of oil spill accidents. This paper proposes a feature extraction method for SAR images based on Curvelet transform. First, we performed discrete Curvelet transform and selected the low-frequency component as a new image matrix, which contains the main information. Then, the Principal Component Analysis (PCA) technique was applied to select the best features to reduce the dimension. Finally, the Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier was used to distinguish between "oil slicks" and "look-alikes oil slicks" and verify the validity of the extracted features. Experiments were performed on the different datasets, and the results proved that the accuracy of recognition is improved with Curvelet transform. In addition, compared with other neural network algorithms, Curvelet transform is an effective way to extract a reduced set of discriminative features for SAR images.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Vehicle Safety Detection and Alarm System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, a vehicle safety detection and alarm system can be used to detect the inside environment of the vehicle. When it is found that the inside environment of the vehicle after parking is bad, and there are people in the car, it can alarm through this system, so as to ensure the safety of personnel.

articleTitle: Outdoor Activity Space Design for the Elderly in Residential Areas
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the continuous development of the economy, the number of the elderly is increasing, and the activities space for the elderly is also bigger and bigger. Therefore, it is very necessary for the design of the outdoor space for the elderly. Through the analysis of the psychology, physiology and social environment of the elderly, the activities of the elderly are classified, and the principles of designing outdoor activities for the elderly, the contents and methods of designing space for the elderly outdoor activities, the ground design of outdoor activities for the elderly are summarized. It includes the design of walkways, plant landscape design for outdoor activities in the elderly, how to choose the appropriate plant landscape for design and how to design private space. This paper has done a detailed elaboration for above content and provided some reference for the design of outdoor activities for the elderly.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Resource Allocation Algorithm in Non-orthogonal Multiple Access
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Resource allocation is an important part of non-orthogonal multiple access technology. How to allocate resources reasonably to achieve high service quality has become an important research topic. The existing resource allocation algorithms have the disadvantages of low system performance improvement, inability to achieve dynamic resource allocation, and high complexity. In view of the limitations of the existing resource allocation methods, this paper proposes to minimize the power consumption of the base station by obtaining the minimum power required by the terminal to reach the target rate under certain fairness constraints, and at the same time obtain the channel state through the base station. The information calculates the actual rate reached by the terminal in real time. If the rate is lower than a certain value, the resources are reallocated to achieve dynamic resource allocation. Finally, the simulation shows that the performance of the proposed algorithm is improved when the terminal is fixed. When the terminal moves, the system performance is greatly improved and the base station energy consumption is reduced.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Design of Ship Monitoring System Based on Hybrid Replication Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: As the core of informatization, data has a huge significance to the development of information-based enterprises. Data replication technology is an important approach to solve the problem of enterprise data sharing based on distributed database system. It plays a crucial role in promoting business integration of enterprises and institutions, improving data quality, enhancing data sharing and improving the application level of back-end big data analysis [1]. It is necessary to do research for making a good data management of the distributed database application system, synchronizing the data to the data, preventing data conflicting and being able to synchronize or asynchronous replication. Combining with the database design model of the ship monitoring and control system, this paper mainly described how to complete the construction of distributed database system using Oracle, based on advanced replication technology named as the combination of multi-agent replication and materialized views hybrid replication technology.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Clock Source of Railway Time Synchronization Network Based on SPN
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Railway time synchronization network is an important part of railway communication network. It provides unified and standard time information for railway system. As the timing reference signal source of railway time synchronization network, the reliability of clock source is the basis to ensure the accuracy and precision of the time information of railway time synchronization network. So it is of great significance to do the study about the reliability of clock source to the realization of railway time synchronization. In accordance with failover principle, in this thesis, three levels master clock failover models were established by using Stochastic Petri Nets (SPN) first, and then the TimeNET software was used to check structure and analyze steady state of models. The analysis results showed that master clocks of all levels with high reliability can meet the requirements of clock source of railway time synchronization network.
