articleTitle: The Modeling Research of Soybean Meal Option Implied Volatility Surface Based on the Linear Polynomial Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: On the basis of studying the data characteristics of soybean meal option, in this article, we changed Dumas Linear Polynomial model, by enhancing the power of polynomial of parameter τ, to obtain several models. And based on the market data, we tested these models with different perspectives and the consequences are effective. From the result of the experiments, we can conclude four principles as followed. Firstly, with the complexity of model increased, the model can outperform on the side of data explanation. Secondly, it was going to present over-fitting if the model gets more complicated, which weakened the model's prediction ability. Thirdly, although the more complex models outperformed, the basic one with power of polynomial of parameter τ equaled one also conducted well in prediction. Fourthly, we developed that as the power of polynomial of parameter τ equaled two, the algorithm presented better ranging from fitness to prediction, which is adapted to establish the model of soybean meal options with intraday quotation.

articleTitle: Research on Disc-Type Continuous Continuous Casting System Based on TRIZ Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: TRIZ theory is a powerful theory, method and tool of technological innovation. Its thinking method and problem analysis method effectively break the inertia of thinking and have a complete solution to the contradiction of the problem. The TRIZ theory will be used to study the non-ferrous metal automatic casting system, breaking the manual fixed casting or linear automatic casting of non-ferrous metal ingots (mainly tin, aluminum, copper, lead, etc.), using disc-type fixed mold Continuous automatic casting system keeps the mold fixed, metal liquid casting and cooling forming are completely carried out under static conditions, which can greatly improve the surface quality of the metal ingot, and realize the whole process of PLC automation by casting, demoulding, conveying and stacking., can greatly reduce the labor intensity of the operator, greatly improve the level of equipment automation and labor productivity.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Updating Technology of Multi-core Network Simulation Software
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and timeliness of the remote update of simulation software, the remote update technology of multi-core network simulation software is deeply studied. Firstly, the multi-core network hierarchical architecture is divided, and the network node distribution position is set in combination with the network structure so as to accurately acquire and update node data information, and the software remote update data resources are integrated in combination with the node information to finally form a remote update data packet. Combined with neural network algorithm, multi-core processing of software remote update data packet is carried out to complete real-time remote update of dynamic and static data, and finally the improvement of multi-core network simulation software remote update technology is realized. Finally, the simulation experiment proves that the multi-core network simulation software remote update technology has significantly improved the accuracy and timeliness compared with the traditional software remote update technology.

articleTitle: The Design and Implement of Neusoft Education Online Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: According to the actual needs of Dalian Neusoft University of Information, Neusoft Education Online (NEO) Platform is proposed in this paper. The traditional education model is teacher-centered, with the popularity of the Internet, colleges and universities are increasingly relying on student-centered education model. At first the requirements of NEO platform is analyzed and the system functions are describes in a modular way. Then, according to the content of the requirement analysis, the functional modules of the system are divided and the database is designed. In the process of system implementation, NEO Framework is used, and creating a new non-standard course is taken as an example that explains the implementation process. The NEO platform has been put into use, and the system is safe, stable and interactive, and has rich teaching content and presentation form. In the future, more work will be done to improve system functions and efficiency.

articleTitle: Kinetic Study of Power Strip Enclosure Materials Pyrolysis Made from the Fire Retardant Polypropylene Using Non-Isothermal TGA Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Pyrolysis characteristics and kinetic study of power strip enclosure made from fire retardant polypropylene in air/nitrogen at different heating rates was investigated using thermogravimetric analysis. To describe the pyrolysis behaviour, the modified Coast Redfern method was used. The phenomenon was described by different models indicating that the pyrolysis followed the same pyrolysis mechanism in the corresponding stages at different heating rates of 10°C/min and 20°C/min, namely the phase-phase reaction mechanism, the random nucleation and the growth mechanism, respectively. When the heating rate was at 30°C/min, the pyrolysis mechanism in the corresponding stage was inconsistent. In addition, in air, the total activation energy of the material was greater than that in nitrogen, and the overall thermal stability of the material in air was better. The study will provide useful information for fire departments to prevent, suppress and investigate related power strip fires caused by electrical malfunction.

Author Keywords: scanning electron microscope (SEM) energy dispersive spectrum analysis (EDS)

articleTitle: Prediction of Quasi - Fluid Performance in Different Volume Concentration of Deep Sea Mining
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The centrifugal pump can not meet the technical requirements of deep-sea mining in performance and structure. Moreover, coarse particles and water was regarded as a research object. In order to study the performance of deep sea mining, this article uses a new type of electric pump as a model. At the same time, there are different diameter particles in deep-sea mining. The force of the coarse particles in the quasi-fluid is analyzed by CFturbo for 3D modeling and extracting the flow path of the quasi-fluid. The ICEM is used for the meshing, and the quasi-fluid at the concentration of 5%, 8% and 10% was selected. The Particle model was used for numerical simulation in CFX to predict the electric pump performance from the results obtained. Using two-stage electric pump to do the water test, the data obtained with the numerical simulation results are compared. It shows that when the particle concentration is 10% in the deep sea mining, the system is more stable and the efficiency and the head are more reasonable.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Statistics of Electronic Commerce Data Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on RFID and Internet of things technology, the method of automatic statistics of the data in and out of electronic commerce has been studied to improve the management ability of electronic commerce. An automatic statistics method of electronic commerce access database is proposed based on distributed wireless RFID in Internet of things. In this paper, the adaptive distributed optimization positioning design of the Internet of things node is carried out, and the distributed data structure model of the data in and out of the database in the cloud service combination mode is constructed. This paper adopts descriptive statistical analysis method to deal with the information fusion of the data in and out of the storehouse of electronic commerce, and combines the multiplex Internet of things scheduling technology to deal with the packet sample detection of the data in and out of the storehouse of the electronic commerce. The RFID method is used to mine and extract the data of electronic commerce, and to realize the automatic statistics of the data in and out of the storehouse of electronic commerce. The simulation results show that the proposed method has good automatic clustering ability, fast statistical rate and high feature matching ability. It has a good application value in the statistics and monitoring of the data in and out of the storehouse of electronic commerce.

articleTitle: Exploration of Regional Economic Development Gap and Coordinated Development Path in Inner Mongolia Area Dependent on the Extended Dijstra Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The exploration of the development gap and the coordinated development path is a kind of exploration behavior based on the data flow among the regional economies in Inner Mongolia area. In this paper, Dijstra algorithm is combined to explore the regional economic development gap and the coordinated development path in Inner Mongolia area. The algorithm can be used to achieve the exploration on the regional economic development gap and the coordinated development path in Inner Mongolia area. Through several preconditions and a conclusion, the defeasible rule for the effective tender can be obtained. In addition, the process of deduction is explored through the dialogue tree. Verification and analysis on the algorithm is carried out through the instances. The final result shows that, for the regional economy in Inner Mongolia area, the algorithm put forward in this paper can be used to implement the exploration on the regional economic development gap and the coordinated development path in Inner Mongolia area.

Author Keywords: Regional Economy in Inner Mongolia Area

articleTitle: Development and Application of Network Teaching System for Graphic Design Courses in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on current situation of education and teaching, this paper analyzes, designs and implements the network teaching system of graphic design courses in higher vocational colleges. Firstly, the information engineering method is used to solve the problem in design and development of complex information system. The system is planned from the aspects of data source, system target and demand structure, and corresponding system requirement model is established. Then, the design model of network teaching system is constructed based on the idea of component-based hierarchical architecture, with the design work of interface, database, test case and the function of approval process in the system are completed for each module in the model. In the system implementation stage, the construction of the network teaching system database is completed, and the workflow links in the system are developed and configured. Finally, the actual effect of the system is analyzed and relevant conclusions are provided.

articleTitle: A Path Planning Algorithm in Express Delivery Services
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the detour problem at the end of Express delivery, and provide more convenient planning path for the distribution staff, in the genetic algorithm, the cross-factor is removed, and the simulated annealing acceptance criteria are used to determine the individuals entering the next generation population during the crossover and mutation, adjust each generation crossover and mutation to accept the probability of poor solution and avoid the population to stop evolving. The simulation results show that the improved path planning algorithm not only effectively eliminates the phenomenon of the local optimal solution, but also shortens the algorithm to the original 1/4, the execution time to the original 1/3, the Courier distribution total route is shortened by 10%, which has improved distribution efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of Artillery Monitoring System Based on TMS320F2812
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The paper introduces one design method of monitored control system based on DSP. According to the actual needs of artillery monitoring module, using TMS320F2812 as the main chip, build input and output control circuit, A/D conversion circuit, CAN bus communication circuit, realized the function of input and output control and bus communication for artillery system. The paper elaborates hardware and software which provides a solution for the design of gun control system.

articleTitle: Research on Online Monitoring Technology for Metal Sheet Paint Thickness
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper uses multi-frequency eddy current non-destructive testing method to detect the thickness of metal baking varnish of metal sheet. Through sinusoidal signal generation module, signal acquisition module, signal conditioning circuit and data acquisition module to obtain detection signal of the metal sheet paint thickness. LabVIEW and Matlab calculate the obtained data, and finally calculate the thickness of each layer of metal sheet metal baking varnish. The platform has a USB camera set up at the experimental site, and through LabVIEW's visual development module, provides an intuitive experimental environment and timely feedback of experimental phenomena for remote registrants.

Author Keywords: non-destructive testing, thickness detection, multi-frequency eddy current testing system

articleTitle: Implementation of Land Merging Function Based on Big Data of ArcGIS Engine and C#.net
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the experience in the combination of theory and practice of ArcGIS Engine in the development of GIS technology in recent years, this paper combines with the map elements of important data sources of GIS basic frame to make the plot smaller than or equal to the given value merge into the largest surrounding land by C# language and COM components technology. And this research achievement plays an important and practical role in the land using and cadastre rectification.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Urban Land Use Structure Based on Big Data on Space Performance in Kunming
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the big data of urban land use, this paper calculates and analyzes the changes in Kunming's urban land use structure in 2003, 2008 and 2014 respectively, constructs the index system of Kunming's urban space performance, and performs the linear regression analysis on the information entropy and performance value of the land use structure by SPSS software based on the space performance value calculated by comprehensive evaluation model after calculation of the weight of each index by AHP decision analysis method . The results show that Kunming's urban land use structure was constantly improving and tending to be balanced during the study period. With the change of urban land use structure, the value of urban space performance also increased accordingly, indicating that the information entropy of urban land structure has a certain pulling effect on space performance.

articleTitle: The Application of Big Data Technology in Creative Travel
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet of Things and communication technology and the arrival of the era of big data, the construction of Intelligent Tourism is no longer an unrealistic slogan. The construction of smart tourism destination is in line with the strategic objective of China's tourism development. User behavior interest data are simulated artificially. Then, the features of tourist attractions, tourist routes and user behavior interest are extracted in the tourism field, and the user interest feature model is established. This paper briefly analyzes the application of big data in the tourism industry, promoting the effective application of big data in the tourism industry, further promoting the vigorous development of the tourism industry.

articleTitle: Design of Bidirectional Bus Based on Verilog HDL
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper designs a bidirectional bus based on Verilog HDL and its application in gun control system. The correctness of the design is verified by simulation. and the bidirectional bus connection is realized on the programmable controller CPLD, which provides a solution for the hardware design of the gun control system.

articleTitle: Optimization Solvers for Convex L1-Regularization Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The convex l1-regularization problem has been received special attentions in the last two decades because of its properties of improving model interpretation. So far, there exists plentiful optimization methods to solve this problem. In this paper, we review the existing optimization methods and compare them to help users choose the most proper solver in their own scenarios.

articleTitle: Enterprise Economic Management Innovation Strategy Based on the Integration of Multivariate Mixture Criterion Fuzzy Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the economy and the times, innovation has become an inevitable trend of the development. In particular, in terms of the economic management of enterprises, major enterprises have strengthened the speed of their innovation and development, which has provided the necessary prerequisites for the further development of the economy of the enterprises. Firstly, the economic management innovation of enterprises is analyzed. In accordance with the problem of the economic management circulation and its timeliness, the multivariate mixture fuzzy model is used to carry out analysis on the whole process of the economic management innovation of the enterprise. In addition, the preemptive EDF scheduling algorithm is combined to optimize the deadline for the economic management, the response time and so on in a dynamic manner. Finally, in view of the economic management innovation strategy, experimental comparison and analysis is carried out. On this basis, the suggestion for effectively obtaining user demand and reducing time cost is put forward to the enterprises.

articleTitle: Design of Permanent Magnet Brushless Automobile Alternator with Electromagnetic Clutch
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The generator is a key component of the automotive power system. It is the source of energy for automotive electrical appliances, storage batteries and vehicle electrical equipment. The main factor affecting the life of the generator is because the power supply link of the engine rotor excitation coil is fed by brush and slip ring. Yes, the mechanical friction of the brush and the slip ring is damaged, which is the root cause of the service life of the generator. This paper introduces a prototype of a brushless permanent magnet automotive alternator that uses electromagnetic clutch for power switching, and maintains the core design of the prototype to the maximum extent to adapt to the modern product; and its principle and structure, performance, characteristics, etc. were analyzed and summarized.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Misoperation Accident of the 220kv Bus Difference Backup Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: As the power grid continues to grow, the number of components on buses is increasing. It requires bus differential protection to integrate reliability and security. This paper has introduced the inspection and handling process of a malfunction accident of 220kV microcomputer bus differential protection. The model bus differential protection was the product after six unified. The basic principle of busbar differential backup protection has been introduced. The causes of misoperation caused by microcomputer bus differential protection are analyzed from three aspects: criterion of operation bus, generation of differential current, and rationality of operation bus voltage blocking. Preventive measures and solutions for preventing malfunction of microcomputer bus differential protection has been given in this paper. Through the suggestion of changing the logic of the criterion of the running bus and the opening of the busbar voltage, the reliability of the protector has been greatly improved and the safe and stable operation of the power grid has been ensured.

Author Keywords: Backup protection of bus differential, Misjudgement, Running busbar, differential current, Bus voltage closure opening

articleTitle: Interlayer Seismic Isolation Analysis on Two-Storey R.C. Frame-Masonry Building
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Bottom frame - masonry building earthquake damage shows poor earthquake resistance. Based on this, the interlayer seismic isolation is adopted at the transition layer, and the theoretical formula of optimal isolation parameter is analysed. The parameters (stiffness and damping) of isolation layer are analysed considering damping of bottom structure and nonlinearity of damper of isolation layer as well as its its correlation with mass ratio. The impact of isolation layer parameters on horizontal vibration displacement of bottom structure is compared to obtain the range of optimal isolation layer parameter. According to the optimized analysis of seismic isolation parameters and combining a certain bottom frame-masonry structure, finite element software ABAQUS is used to establish two finite element models before and after seismic isolation respectively, for structural modal analysis and time-history analysis under seismic effect. The displacement and shear responses of structures before and after seismic isolation are analysed, and comparison shows that its damping effect is remarkable

articleTitle: Fire Evacuation Design and Fire Risk Assessment for a Stadium
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to realize the fire risk assessment of A stadium, this paper establishes the fire scene model of the stadium, and takes the fire model simulation analysis to the stadium. The composition and structure of the stadium, the division of safety zones, evacuation and other aspects are analyzed. The model is established and the fire simulation experiment is carried out. The design requirements are given. Finally, the simulation data are obtained, and improvement suggestions for A venues are given through data. Fire risk assessment plays an important guiding role in improving the fire safety level of the stadium.

articleTitle: Classifications and Functions of Vitreoretinal Surgery Assisted Robots-A Review of the State of the Art
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To overcome the surgeon's manual operation limitations in vitreoretinal microsurgery, many kinds of robots are developed to enhance the operation accuracy, including Master-Slave Teleoperation Robot (MSTR), Hand-Held Robot (HHR), Cooperative Robot (CR) and Micro Robot (MR). With the introduction of vitreoretinal surgical assisted robots (VRSARs), the surgeon's operation skills can be improved through various functions of the robots, such as depth information perception, improvement of the surgical precision, and micro-force perception and feedback. After description and classification of the latest research progress of VRSARs, the current problems of each type of VRSARs were discussed and future works summarized for further research.

articleTitle: Resources Scheduling Algorithm for Multi-relay-Satellite System with Multi-restriction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: According to the multi-restriction in the relay resource scheduling of multi-satellite, a constraint satisfaction model is established. A scheduling algorithm based on ant genetic algorithm is proposed, which optimizes missions scheduling sequence and choices of resources by double-layer coding. Considering the multi-mission, multi-satellite, multi-window and missions PRI, the available time-window is dynamically refreshed according to the conflicts between scheduling missions. The missions scheduling sequence is optimized by ant algorithm with different sizes of windows. The choices of relay satellites resources are optimized by adaptive niche genetic algorithm to achieve optimal scheduling scheme. The simulation result reveals that the double-layer optimization algorithm is better than single-layer optimization algorithm, and the algorithm obtains satisfactory results in both time and optimization, which is suitable for resources scheduling problem with multi-restriction, multi-mission and multi-satellite.

articleTitle: A Conceptual Model for the Urban Regional Fire Safety Capability Maturity Growth States Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: with the ceaseless advancement and change of urban, it is of great emergency to develop a direct and likely-to-be most effective approach to gaining a stepwise insight into the problems of each stage for regulating urban fire demand to promote the fire protection and finding weak links to be made up for in case it is needed. This article is aimed at developing a diagnosis system for scientific measurement and hierarchical evaluation of the capability maturity growth states of a given urban region on fire safety, then improving and enhancing the practice behavior in management and technology continuously as well. To achieve the purpose, first of all, the research framework for urban regional growth states of fire safety-related and the evaluation index system accordingly were constructed with the aid of the capability maturity model theory. Then, the quantitative analysis and empowerment of index factors were carried out by DEMATEL and ANP, moreover the ternary interval numbers evaluation model was used to describe the decision making data, and calculate the maturity level of the urban regional fire safety capability maturity. As an exploration of advanced management idea and method, this study has got a complete conceptual model, and contributes to the providing decision support for the construction of urban fire safety system.

Author Keywords: decision making trial and evaluation laboratory

articleTitle: A Review of Research on Software-Defined Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The development of optical networks has promoted the implementation of high-speed, broadband, long-distance and ultra-large-capacity transmission. However, with the avalanche growth of network scale and data traffic, traditional optical networks have been unable to carry various data center and cloud-based services. There is an urgent need for a more intelligent "brain" in the optical network. The Software-Defined Optical Network (SDON) proposes to solve the above problems effectively. This paper summarizes the research status of SDON at home and abroad from the aspects of SDON development overview, architecture and virtualization technology. And analyze and forecast the challenges and development trends of SDON.
